about: TASK-34a1 ground truth, the judgement part. Labelled inside Kiro on 9 Nov 2026 by the lesson-checker persona (.kiro/agents/lesson-checker.md), read-only, over every wrong answer on every quiz card of the 54 v2 bench files. It is an AI review, not a teacher's. Every distractor NOT listed under 'absurd' was labelled plausible. scripts/build-distractor-review.ts expands this into bench/distractor-review.json with every distractor from the files.
definition: absurd = off-topic, physically silly, or no 8–10-year-old would believe it; plausible = a mistake a pupil who has not learnt it yet might really make (it may still be a weak or easy option).
